items.why: Oil is up again ahead of the flash October inflation data, and surging crude is being cited as dragging on global shares. Energy is leading the tape higher.
Hedge funds just logged their widest daily drawdown since Covid as the rout deepens, and the market is splitting into two camps. The fear gauge is up.
The Nasdaq is gaining as tech stocks bounce back after a sharp sell-off, and chip names are recovering with the tape. AMD is riding that rebound.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Split tape: Dow and S&P lower, Nasdaq green, oil up 3.4%, gold softer, VIX higher.
summary: It is a split tape Friday: the Dow and S&P are dropping while the Nasdaq rebounds after a sharp tech sell-off. Oil keeps climbing into the morning inflation data, and the VIX is up as investors stay uneasy.
